sourceAudit: Live own slots empty. Quality variants derive from inspected base weapon cover, preserve silhouette. Exterior craftsmanship interpretation, no new mechanical capabilities or icon changes.

assets.prompt: Edit the supplied finished fictional game illustration into a HIGH-QUALITY version of the SAME item. Reference role: edit target, preserve exact fundamental object identity, type, silhouette, proportions, component count, setting and composition. Preserve the mature detailed cel-shaded rendering, thin varied ink and broad painted planes, opaque 3:2 landscape, safe framing. Refine material finish: precise clean exterior seams, premium grip/fabric/composite or metal appropriate to this item, controlled polished highlights, careful craftsmanship and subtle restrained decorative accents. Keep it practical and recognizable; no gold fantasy ornament or new capabilities. No text, numbers, logo, labels, UI, diagrams, dimensions, ammunition, firing, target, blood or instructions. Do not add accessories or humans.
assets.exportRecipe: Centered crop and Lanczos3 resize; opaque quality 88, no creative edits
